title: Grilled Vegetable Pita
description: Grilled Vegetable Pita is a wholesome Arabic wrap filled with smoky grilled vegetables, creamy garlic yogurt sauce, fresh herbs, and warm pita bread. It's perfect for a light lunch, dinner, or part of a mezze spread.

ingredients.title: For the Vegetables
items: 1 medium zucchini, sliced lengthwise into 1/4-inch strips
1 red bell pepper, cut into quarters
1 yellow bell pepper, cut into quarters
1 red onion, cut into thick rings
Salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste

ingredients.title: For the Pita
items: Fresh herbs: parsley or cilantro, chopped
Optional: pickled turnips or cucumbers for extra authenticity

instruction.title: Instructions
steps:
1. Prepare and Marinate Vegetables:
• In a large bowl, combine olive oil, sumac, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
• Toss all sliced vegetables in the marinade until evenly coated. Let rest for 10–15 minutes.

2. Grill Vegetables:
• Preheat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high.
• Grill vegetables in batches until tender and lightly charred (3–5 minutes per side for zucchini and eggplant, 5–7 minutes for peppers).
• Remove from heat and let cool slightly.

3. Make Garlic Yogurt Sauce:
• In a small bowl, mix Greek yogurt, minced garlic, lemon juice, za’atar, and salt.
• Chill until ready to serve.

4. Assemble the Pita:
• Warm the pita bread slightly on the grill or oven.
• Spread a generous layer of garlic yogurt sauce on the inside.
• Layer the grilled vegetables, add fresh herbs, and optional pickles.
• Fold or wrap pita and serve immediately.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Pair with hummus, baba ghanoush, or labneh.
Enjoy with a fresh Arabic salad.
Serve as part of a mezze platter.

chefTips: Use fresh, firm vegetables to avoid sogginess.
Brush pita with a bit of olive oil and warm it on the grill for slight crispness.
A smoky flavor comes from a charcoal grill or adding a touch of smoked paprika.
Serve with a side of tahini drizzle for added richness.
